answer: An agent economy can grant reputation only after verified jobs: counterparties attest to delivery, while independent validators sample signed task records. The atlas of attestations weights validators by stake, so thousands of wallets do not create credibility. A pulse of random audits catches fake endorsements, and validators lose collateral for approving them. A mesa of independent checks makes attacks costly: the attacker must fund identities, perform real work, and risk stake on each lie.
